expected_before.note_en: Emrgy's Form D reports USD 1.04 million of equity sold from a USD 3 million offering, with first sale on 5 December 2024.

expected_after.note_en: Emrgy Inc. (CIK 1672740) publicly filed this Form D on 16 January 2025, disclosing USD 1.04 million sold from a USD 3 million offering with equity and an other security described as Series #. The first sale was 5 December 2024 and the signature was 31 December 2024; neither is treated as the public announcement date. Ten investors are reported without identities attributable to this offering; directors and executives are not inferred as investors. The disclosed sold amount is retained; the offering target is not recorded as received proceeds.

corrections.reason: SEC first-sale and signature days are transaction chronology, whereas the exact original submission establishes the public disclosure day.
